title: Additional Financial Aid for Hawkers Affected due to their Proximity to COVID-19 Clusters
what_it_is: Additional Financial Aid for Hawkers Affected due to their Proximity to COVID-19 Clusters

sections.label: Aid for affected hawkers
sections.summary: Asked whether additional financial aid is planned for hawkers affected by a COVID-19 cluster and how crowds will be drawn back.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (a) whether there are any plans to provide additional financial aid to affected hawkers who have been forced to close or seen their business drop significantly due to their proximity to a COVID-19 cluster; and (b) how does the Ministry intend to help draw the crowds back to affected markets and hawker centres once the COVID-19 cluster has closed.

sections.label: Rental waiver and cleaning subsidies
sections.summary: Seven months of rental waiver and five months of cleaning subsidies have been provided since April 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: In all, seven months of rental waiver and five months of subsidies for cleaning have been provided since April 2020.

sections.label: Rentals revised to market rate
sections.summary: Fifty-eight percent of them had their rentals revised downwards to the market rate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Fifty-eight percent of them had their rentals revised downwards to the market rate.

sections.label: Median rent for hawker stall
sections.summary: The median monthly rent for a non-subsidised cooked food hawker stall is $1,250, lower than coffeeshops and food courts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Today, the median monthly rent for a non-subsidised cooked food hawker stall is $1,250 and remains significantly lower than those at coffeeshops and food courts.

sections.label: Cleaning and community support efforts
sections.summary: NEA works with stakeholders on deep cleaning and disinfection, and advisers can rally the community to support hawkers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA has been working with stakeholders such as cleaning companies and Town Councils to ensure proper deep cleaning and disinfection of common areas and the adoption of robust workflows to clean and sanitise tables.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Advisers can also work with their grassroots and the Hawkers' Associations to assure the local community that it is safe to return to these hawker centres when they re-open and rally the community to support our hawkers.
